name: Tom Jones
residence: Mills, Natrona County, on the candidate filing; in his 2024 WyoFile questionnaire he wrote Casper and that he had lived there 59–60 years
occupation: Business owner and manager; he wrote that he had successfully managed a business for 41 years (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
education: College degrees in agricultural science and agricultural business (institutions not named in the 2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
background: Tom Jones’s 2024 candidate filing lists Mills, Natrona County. In his 2024 WyoFile questionnaire he wrote Casper and that he had lived there 59 or 60 years, and said he would be 67 on Election Day 2024.

He wrote that he has a ranch and agricultural background, college degrees in agricultural science and agricultural business (he did not name the institutions), and that he had successfully managed a business for 41 years. He also wrote that his father was a petroleum engineer and his mother a registered nurse.
